purpose: Cold-start re-verification of the ROS2 port after the host was restarted; all numbers re-derived from artifacts in this repository.

accuracy.metric: ATE, SE(3) aligned, scale fixed to 1, ground truth interpolated to estimate time
accuracy.tolerance: max(5% of baseline, 0.02 m) = 0.02 m -> within tolerance

repeatability.note: Same implementation, same config, same data; the cross-version ROS1-vs-ROS2 difference (1.34 cm) is the same size as this run-to-run spread, so equivalence claims must stay within run-to-run tolerance.

environment.docker_container: fastlivo2-ros1 (network none, /work bind-mounted, /datasets inside the container layer)

checks: calibration read from local node without parameter_blackboard
fractional photometric covariance and outlier threshold accepted

harness_changes: scripts/run_ros2_bag.py: refuses to start when another fastlivo_mapping/ros2 bag play process is alive (records competing_processes, status=failed)

scripts/run_ros1_bag.py and run_ros2_bag.py: record trajectory_span_seconds/trajectory_coverage_fraction, end with status=incomplete_coverage below 0.99, and replace the fixed 8 s drain with drain_until_stable() (bounded 120 s, 6 s quiet window, records drain_seconds)
scripts/audit_coverage.py: re-derives coverage for every stored run and honours QUARANTINE.md markers
